_help: One entry per author, keyed by the name shown on the site (spelling variants are merged in author-names.json).

BIOS (shown ONLY on the author's own page): "bio" is 1-2 sentences written by hand from the sources in "bioSources" and the books we hold. "bioStatus" is one of: "verified" (shown), "from our data only" (no bio; the page shows only the line built from the catalogue), "needs review" (nothing shown until you approve: copy "draftBio" into "bio", or write your own, and set "bioStatus" to "verified"). To remove a bio, set "bio": null and "bioStatus": "from our data only".

PHOTOS come ONLY from Wikimedia Commons, under a free licence (public domain, CC0, CC BY or CC BY-SA), and each is shown with its credit and licence. "photo" is the small copy (lists, cards); "photoLarge" the big portrait on the author's page (never enlarged; "lowRes": true means the original is under 480px wide). To REMOVE a photo set "photo": null and rebuild. To ADD one, put the Wikipedia article title in "wikipedia", then run: node scripts/fetch_author_photos.mjs
Authors with no photo get a navy-and-gold badge with their initials.

neverPhoto: the Prophet, the Imams, Lady Fatima and other members of the Ahlul-Bayt and holy figures, including books attributed to them. They NEVER get a photo or any picture, and are never searched for. The site enforces this even if a photo is added by mistake. Their bios are left for you to write.
